title: Monogram T-Shirt
description: Crafted in airy cotton piqué, this vibrant orange short-sleeved T-shirt adds a bold burst of color to a look. It is adorned with a printed Monogram Reporter motif with a subtly faded finish. A retro Louis Vuitton signature patch adorns this piece above the left hem, while a leather LV patch is sewn on the back under the collar. Regular fit. 100% Cotton. Ribbed collar. Made in Italy.

title: Graphic T-Shirt
description: This white organic cotton T-shirt is given a colorful graphic twist with an LV Daily comic strip motif. Printed on the chest and back, it features tone-on-tone Louis Vuitton Paris embroidery on the chest and a woven label on the back. Regular fit. 100% Cotton. Ribbed collar. Made in Italy.

title: Layered Long-Sleeved T-Shirt
description: Casual long-sleeved T-shirt with a black short-sleeved T-shirt layered over long beige Monogram cotton piqué sleeves topped with graphic stripes. Contrasting Louis Vuitton Paris embroidery on the chest, a tan band inside the ribbed collar, woven signature patch on the back. Relaxed fit. 100% Cotton. Made in Italy.

title: Signature Detail Short-Sleeved T-Shirt
description: Classic T-shirt in chocolate brown, crafted in premium organic cotton with a contrasting black ribbed collar. Cuffs and hem carry tonal Monogram Flowers on black trim; LV signature on the chest. Regular fit. 100% cotton. Made in Italy.

title: Relaxed T-Shirt
description: Casual T-shirt in dark blue with an easy, relaxed fit and a graphic contrasting signature on the chest, printed with a faded vintage effect. A tan band inside the collar. 100% Cotton. Ribbed collar. Made in Italy.
